facts.fact: Ouestaf News reports that Senegal's access to information law was promulgated on 4 September 2025 and has since entered into force.
Ouestaf News reports that the decree on the organisation and functioning of CONAI was signed in October 2025, though CONAI is still not operational.
facts.system: Décret portant organisation et fonctionnement de la CONAI

facts.fact: Ouestaf News reports that on 16 April 2026 the Supreme Court declared inadmissible a former magistrate's request for information on political funds because he had not first seized CONAI.
